name: PercentageOfCardsWithoutPowerInFrench
definition: Percentage of cards lacking power that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French' AND CardPower IS NULL OR CardPower = '*') / COUNT(CardPower IS NULL OR CardPower = '*') * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = tb005.cl0163; CardPower = tb004.cl0143
aliases: percentage of cards without power in French
percentage of cards without power in french

name: MonthlyAverageSchoolsOpenedIn1980
definition: Average number of schools opened per month in 1980 in Alameda County under Elementary School District. Formula: COUNT(SchoolOpenDate YEAR = 1980 AND SchoolCounty = 'Alameda' AND SchoolDistrictType = 52) / 12. Inputs: SchoolOpenDate = tb003.cl0041; SchoolCounty = tb003.cl0042; SchoolDistrictType = tb003.cl0065 WHERE cl0065 = 52
aliases: monthly average number of schools opened in 1980

name: PercentageOfCommanderLegalCardsWithoutContentWarning
definition: Percentage of commander-format legal cards that have no content warning. Formula: COUNT(CardContentWarning = 0 AND CardFormat = 'commander' AND CardLegality = 'legal') / COUNT(CardFormat = 'commander' AND CardLegality = 'legal') * 100. Inputs: CardContentWarning = tb004.cl0110; CardFormat = tb006.cl0164; CardLegality = tb006.cl0165
aliases: percentage of commander legal cards without content warning

name: EligibleFreeRate
definition: Share of students eligible for free/reduced meals Formula: SchoolEligibleFreeCount / SchoolEnrollment. Inputs: SchoolEligibleFreeCount = tb001.cl0020; SchoolEnrollment = tb001.cl0019

name: FrenchCardPercentage
definition: Percentage of cards in a group that are French Formula: COUNT(Card WHERE CardLanguage='French') / COUNT(Card) * 100. Inputs: Card = tb004.cl0089; CardLanguage = tb005.cl0163
aliases: percentage of cards whose language is French

name: ConsumptionGrowthRate
definition: Percentage change in consumption between two years Formula: (Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) / Consumption_2013 * 100. Inputs: TransactionDate = tb025.cl0251

name: CardCount
definition: Count of distinct cards matching a condition Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT Card). Inputs: Card = tb004.cl0089

name: ExpenseTotal
definition: Sum of expense amounts Formula: SUM(ExpenseAmount). Inputs: ExpenseAmount = tb041.cl0315

name: AnnualAvgConsumption
definition: Average monthly consumption times 12 Formula: AVG(MonthlyConsumption) * 12. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = tb014.cl0198

name: EventBudgetDifference
definition: Difference in total event budget between two years Formula: SUM(EventBudget WHERE YEAR(EventDate)=2019) - SUM(EventBudget WHERE YEAR(EventDate)=2020). Inputs: EventBudget = tb040.cl0308; EventDate = tb036.cl0290 WHERE cl0290 BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

name: RaceCompletionPercentage
definition: Share of race entries that were completed Formula: RaceCompletion / RaceEntryCount * 100. Inputs: RaceCompletion = tb025.cl0251 WHERE cl0251 IS NOT NULL; Driver = tb025.cl0255

name: MonthlyConsumptionAbove1000
definition: Flag/count of customers with monthly consumption above 1000 Formula: CASE WHEN MonthlyConsumption > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = tb014.cl0198

name: LoanAmountBelow100k
definition: Flag/count of loans with amount below 100000 Formula: CASE WHEN LoanAmount < 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: LoanAmount = tb019.cl0221
